scope: authentication, authorization, API surface, secrets handling, AI integration

findings.evidence: API credential audit — OAuth token endpoint rejected client pair
findings.impact: Satellite features silently fail; stale config implies unmanaged secret
findings.recommendation: Regenerate or remove Sentinel Hub credentials

findings.vulnerability: FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS_JSON points to a nonexistent file
findings.evidence: env value is a path; file absent on disk
findings.recommendation: Provide valid service-account JSON or disable Firebase features

findings.vulnerability: SMTP_HOST does not resolve — alert email channel dead
findings.recommendation: Configure a reachable SMTP host or disable email alerts

findings.vulnerability: Seeded demo accounts with a shared env password present in deployment
findings.evidence: seeder.py creates 4 demo users from DEMO_USER_PASSWORD
findings.impact: Predictable credentials if env reused in production
findings.recommendation: Restrict seeding to dev environments or rotate passwords post-seed

findings.vulnerability: Empty error responses cached briefly on some endpoints
findings.evidence: india heatmap [] cached 120s under wrong key state during earlier work
findings.recommendation: Skip caching empty payloads for provider-backed endpoints

findings.vulnerability: None — JWT access+refresh rotation, bcrypt hashing, role deps verified
findings.evidence: deps.py require_roles, refresh single-flight, secure cookies

findings.vulnerability: None — key backend-only, frozen validation pipeline, no secret exposure
